description: Header file defining the TR-069 API for MoCA Interface QoS FlowStats, including class declaration, getter methods, and API documentation.

classes.name: MoCAInterfaceQoSFlowStats
classes.description: Class encapsulating the API to retrieve QoS Flow Statistics for MoCA Interface, implementing singleton pattern with various getter methods.

methods.name: get_FlowID
methods.description: Retrieves the FlowID used to identify a flow in the network, based on mocaIfFlowID from [MOCA11-MIB].

methods.name: get_PacketDA
methods.description: Retrieves the Destination Address for packets in the flow.

methods.name: get_MaxRate
methods.description: Retrieves the maximum required rate in Kbps for the flow.

methods.name: get_MaxBurstSize
methods.description: Retrieves the maximum burst size of the MoCA interface flow.

methods.name: get_LeaseTime
methods.description: Retrieves the flow lease time in seconds; 0 indicates unlimited lease time.

methods.name: get_LeaseTimeLeft
methods.description: Retrieves the remaining lease time in seconds; 0 indicates unlimited or expired lease.

methods.name: get_FlowPackets
methods.description: Retrieves the number of packets transmitted for this flow.
